name: offer-list
title: Offer list
description: Other offers for the same product: seller and rating, condition, delivery and the price with shipping, sortable, with the best price named and an add button per row.
docs: offers holds one entry per seller: id, seller, rating and ratingCount, condition ('new', 'like-new', 'very-good', 'good' or 'acceptable'), price and shipping in minor units (shipping 0 is free), delivery as { from, to? } ISO days and an optional note. The cheapest price with shipping is marked 'Best price' in words and with a bar on the row (highlightBest, on by default, needs two offers or more). The list sorts itself by price with shipping, delivery, condition or the seller's rating (the Seller rating column): pass sort and onSort to control it, or defaultSort; offers that tie are put cheapest first, offers without a rating go last, and the change is announced ('Sorted by price, lowest first'). The column heads are real sort buttons with aria-sort. Each condition is a tooltip on the table, reachable from the keyboard; on a device without hover the meaning is written out under the badge instead. Below the container width of 56rem the table becomes cards with a sort control, the condition written out under its badge and the same information. onAdd(offer) may return a promise: the button shows it is working, then 'Added' for a moment, and it is announced; without onAdd there are no buttons. Pass currency, locale and timeZone, so amounts and days read the same on the server and in the browser. A delivery given as a date only ('2026-11-05') is a calendar day and reads the same in every time zone; timeZone places the ones that carry a time of day. labels holds every word, the conditions and their explanations included. sortOffers, totalOf and deliveryText are exported from offers.ts.
